survey: A red telephone box in three-quarter view, standing on a dark grey plinth that touches the floor all round. Two glazed faces are visible. The left face is a fixed panel of small glass panes. The front-right face is the door, with a vertical metal pull handle on its left edge, so the hinges would be on the right. Both faces have a full grid of glazing bars. The domed roof carries two illuminated sign panels, one per face, each topped by a gold crown. Inside, a grey payphone is fixed to the back wall and seen through the door glass. It has a small green screen, a keypad and a dark handset hung on its left side. A curly cord runs from the bottom of the unit and loops back toward the handset. Every part sits on or is fixed to something: the box rests on the plinth, the phone is mounted on the wall, and the door has a handle where you would pull it. The proportions are simplified but buildable.
